walkthrough: Goal: watch the picture I drew come about again, stroke by stroke, as the record holds it: to see how I worked, to show someone, before making a video of it.
Before: on a canvas I ink a closed shape and a wave, drop colour into the shape (ColorDrop), add Layer 2 in Layers and draw two strokes on it.

Entry: Actions (the spanner in the left island). Under Share, after Share JPEG…, the row Replay… after a play icon, with the record's strokes quiet at its right ('4 strokes'). On a practice sheet there is no such row; on a canvas with nothing drawn it is pencil grey and does nothing.

Open: a tap closes Actions and the replay takes the screen: the studio's bars and islands go, Back at the top left, Export video… at the top right; the canvas at fit between the top band and a bar along the bottom. It starts at once from blank paper and plays at 4x: each stroke grows as the pen drew it, a thin ring at the pen's tip; the fill appears whole in its turn; Layer 2's strokes come in their turn over it, every layer with its final opacity and blend.

The bar: Pause in its ring at the left, the track with the playhead, over it the stroke at the playhead ('14 Nov 21:07 · stroke 3', its day and time when the stroke kept them; 'Stroke 3' for a stroke from before this version) and the time ('0:01 / 0:02', at the bar's speed), a mark where a new sitting began (a gap of 30 minutes or more); at the right 1x 4x 16x, the chosen in the ink pill.

Gestures: Pause stops it where it is (Play again). A tap or a drag on the track moves the playhead there: the canvas shows the picture at that moment, a stroke drawn halfway if the place falls inside it. 1x 4x 16x change the speed at once, playing or paused, and the times on the bar change with it. At the end it stops on the finished picture, Play shown: a tap plays it again from blank paper. The pen and fingers on the canvas do nothing: no stroke, no zoom, no menu.

Close: Back (or the system's back) closes it: the studio comes back exactly as it was, the artwork the same to the pixel, its view, its tools, its layers; the speed chosen is the next replay's while the app runs.

Undo: the replay changed nothing and is no step: Undo undoes the last stroke drawn before it, as if the replay had not been opened. Failure: none: the replay reads only what is in memory. Reopen: the artwork reopened replays the same; a stroke drawn in this version keeps its day and time in the file.
Not here: undone strokes and deleted layers never replay (the record has only what is kept); a layer shows its last properties throughout; no replay of practice sheets.
